observations: Image API supports state, q (filename/ID/SHA-256), format, visibility, gps, sort new/old/large/small and cursor pagination.
PATCH accepts only visibility; batch supports trash, restore, purge and visibility for up to 500 IDs.
Upload accepts an optional visibility part and returns duplicate=true for an existing image.
Error strings in web/src/lib/api.ts are reused for upload errors in the prototype.
inferences: Tags, rename, date-range and source filters need new backend work and are shown only behind the extension toggle.
limitations: The production SPA ships the rejected darkroom design; its layout and metaphor copy carry no authority.

observations: Neutral grey surfaces (canvas, base, recessed, hairline) with a single blue action colour.
Dark mode uses near-black canvas and a brighter blue action colour around #056DFF.
inferences: A restrained neutral palette with one blue accent matches the user's request for an R2-console look.
